targets.rawSql: SELECT user_id::text AS user, count(*) AS calls, sum(amount)::bigint AS total_credits, count(DISTINCT model_code) AS models_used FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total_credits DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: 近 24h 退款率最高用户
panels.description: refund_total / consume_total > 30% 视为异常 (黑产 / 滥用).

targets.rawSql: WITH per_user AS (SELECT user_id, sum(CASE WHEN kind IN ('consume','settle') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS consume_total, sum(CASE WHEN kind = 'refund' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund_total FROM billing.events WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT user_id::text AS user, consume_total, refund_total, CASE WHEN consume_total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round((refund_total::numeric / consume_total::numeric * 100), 2) END AS refund_pct FROM per_user WHERE consume_total > 100 AND refund_total > 0 ORDER BY refund_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

panels.title: 近 24h 高频 release 用户 (hold 频繁取消)
panels.description: 短时间多次 user_cancel release = 用户在 retry 风暴 / 客户端 bug.

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_id::text AS user, count(*) AS releases, sum(amount)::bigint AS released_credits FROM billing.events WHERE kind = 'release' AND reason = 'user_cancel' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY user_id HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY releases DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: 近 24h 过期未结算 (sink/reaper 健康)
panels.description: kind=release reason=expired = ReapExpired 释放. 数量陡增意味着上游异常 (chat 流断 / aigc worker 挂).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS hour, count(*) AS expired_holds, sum(amount)::bigint AS released_credits FROM billing.events WHERE kind = 'release' AND reason = 'expired' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: 卡死的 held (expires_at < now 但 status='held')
panels.description: 正常应为 0; 非 0 = ReapExpired 没跑或 PG 锁阻塞.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM identity.credit_holds WHERE status = 'held' AND expires_at < now()
